PHONE.TITLE: Phone

STATUS.failed: The PBX did not accept the extension

HINTS.offline: The phone keeps retrying on its own. If it takes long, check the internet or talk to the administrator.
HINTS.failed: The extension may have changed in Settings. Click Reconnect.
HINTS.other_tab: The phone works in one tab at a time, and calls ring there. To answer here, bring it to this tab.

PHONE.ECHO_HINT: You hear your own voice back: checks microphone, headset and internet.

ERRORS.NOT_READY: The phone is not connected to the PBX.
ERRORS.IN_CALL: Finish the current call before making another one.
ERRORS.OTHER_TAB: The phone is in another tab. Call from there or bring it to this tab with the phone button in the sidebar.

PHONE.TEAM_EMPTY: No colleague with an active extension.

ENDED.UNAVAILABLE: Number not allowed or line unavailable
ENDED.MICROPHONE: The browser did not allow the microphone
ENDED.EXTENSION_OFFLINE: Extension offline: the person does not have Chatwoot open or the extension is off

CALL.TRANSFER_HINT: The call goes straight to the chosen extension.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Telephony
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: The CRM call center: operator data, numbers per state and seller extensions. After saving, the PBX updates itself within 30 seconds.
SETTINGS.ENABLED_HELP: When off, the phone disappears for everyone and the PBX has no extensions.

STATUS.OFFLINE: No contact with the PBX since {time}
STATUS.NEVER: The PBX has not connected yet

REGISTRATION.Rejected: The operator refused the username or password
REGISTRATION.Retrying: Trying to register with the operator
REGISTRATION.NONE: No operator registration (operator data missing, or authentication by IP)

STATUS.TOKEN_OK: PBX token set on the server
STATUS.TOKEN_MISSING: OUTSIDER_VOICE_TOKEN is missing in the server .env (see the installation guide)

PASTE.TITLE: Operator data
PASTE.DESCRIPTION: Paste the e-mail or text the operator sent and click Fill: the system finds server, username, password, IPs and numbers (with the state from the area code). Then check and save.
PASTE.NOTHING: No SIP account data found in this text. Fill the fields by hand.

TRUNK.PASSWORD_SET: Password saved. Leave blank to keep it.
TRUNK.IPS_HELP: One per line: where the operator sends calls from. Empty uses the server above.
TRUNK.DIAL_FORMAT: How the operator wants the number dialed

NUMBERS.TITLE: Numbers per state
NUMBERS.DESCRIPTION: A call to a number rings the sellers of its state, and each seller calls out with the number of their state.
NUMBERS.LABEL: Nickname (optional)

AGENTS.TITLE: Extensions
AGENTS.DESCRIPTION: People with an active extension use the phone in Chatwoot. Extensions 100 to 599 (600 is the audio test).

RINGING.TITLE: Ringing and addresses
RINGING.RING_HELP: Incoming call: rings the owner of the customer's deal, then adds the sellers of the number's state and finally everyone.
RINGING.OWNER_FIRST: Ring the owner of the customer's deal first
RINGING.WS_URL_HELP: E.g. wss://voice.yourcompany.com/ws (the address created in the Cloudflare tunnel).
RINGING.PUBLIC_IP_HELP: E.g. 69.6.250.129. Needed for the operator audio to reach the PBX.

SETTINGS.SAVED: Telephony saved. The PBX updates within 30 seconds.
SETTINGS.INVALID: Check the fields marked in red.

GOALS_SETTINGS.TITLE: Call goals
GOALS_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Monthly goal per seller: calls made and minutes on calls. In the panel, the daily goal is the monthly one divided by business days.
GOALS_SETTINGS.NO_PEOPLE: Nobody has an active extension. Set up extensions in Telephony.
GOALS_SETTINGS.HELP: Leave empty for no goal. The change applies to the chosen month and the following ones; earlier months stay as they were.

RETURN.TITLE: To call back
RETURN.DESCRIPTION: Incoming calls nobody answered. They leave the list when someone calls back and the customer answers.

SECTION.TITLE: Telephony
SECTION.NO_ACCESS: Telephony is off. The administrator turns it on in Telephony > Settings.

GOAL.TITLE: Monthly goal
GOAL.MISSING: {calls} calls and {minutes} min to go · {perDay} calls per business day in the {days} days left
GOAL.NO_GOAL: No call goal this month. The administrator sets it in Telephony > Settings > Call goals.
